title: Page 6
content_zh:
戚家，京城内数一数二的富商，从事茶楼、镳局、布庄、钱庄四种买卖，各由戚家四位公子掌管打理，可以说是无人不知、无人不晓，在商界内的势力可是大得吓人。
不管是戚家的哪一种买卖，在京城里都是最赚钱的，谁都比不上，不过树大招风，对戚家事业眼红的人自然也多，当然了，存心挑战扯后腿的人也不少。
「这是怎么一回事？我只不过暂时离京半个月而已，『无戚茶楼』就安静得出奇，来喝茶的客人只剩小猫两、三只，简直冷清到了极点。」
瞧瞧这是什么情况？掌柜闲到在嗑瓜子，跑堂的闲到在一旁打瞌睡，就连进来喝茶的那两、三只小猫，也边喝茶边发呆，整个魂都不知道神游太虚到哪里去了。
坐在三楼的雅座上，掌管茶楼生意的四公子戚无雍单手支着下巴，瞧着一、二楼冷清的光景，内心正困惑不已，不明白这到底是怎么一回事。
他身穿自家布庄出产的墨绿色高级锦缎，腰系上好白玉坠饰，举手投足之间自然展现出一股浑然天成的贵公子傲气，让人难以忽视，再加上他端正的样貌、上好的家世，是不少京城闺女们心仪的对象。
他微拧着眉，快速翻阅王管事送上来的帐簿，才知道这半个月来茶楼的生意急速下滑，就像是从山顶摔下崖谷一样，只有一个字可以形容，那就是「惨」呀！
他也只不过到外地去探望久违的朋友而已，结果一回来无戚茶楼就风云变色，要不是亲眼看到，根本不敢相信会有这样的事情。
难道历史悠久、一代传一代的无戚茶楼就要在他戚家四公子戚无雍的手上败掉了，还背上一个千古骂名，从此在戚家再也抬不起头来？
「啧，这怎么行？本公子可不会让这种事情发生的！」
啪地一声合上帐簿，戚无雍马上凝肃起脸，压迫感十足地唤道：「王管事。」
「是的，四公子。」一直随侍在一旁的王管事赶紧应声。
王管事很清楚主子的脾气，其实主子平常还满随兴潇洒的，并不会摆架子，但是只要主子一板起脸，还隐隐散发出让人感到有压力的气势，那就是主子生气了，可轻忽不得。
「这半个月来，无戚茶楼到底是怎么一回事？」
一提起无戚茶楼的惨况，王管事瞬间苦着一张脸，只差没直接落泪了。「还不是隔街那一间『醉茗居』，他硬是抢走了我们的顾客。」
「醉茗居？」戚无雍没好气地皱起眉头。「那一家茶馆又做了什么事，真是无聊透顶。」
说起最近一年新开张的醉茗居，同样是卖茶的，却老是爱找他们无戚茶楼的麻烦，举凡茶种、价钱、店小二的服务态度，他们都想一较高下，简直就是以抢走无戚茶楼的顾客为乐。
「四公子，是这样的，最近半个月来，醉茗居推出了新的稀奇茶种，不论身分贵贱，只要在他们馆内累积点满十壶的茶，就可以喝到那新的稀奇茶种，而且价钱还是……」
「免费？」啧啧啧，真是不得了呀，他还真担心那个醉茗居的万老板会因为想打垮他们而血本无归，这样他会狂笑不……
「不对，是半价。」

王管事的指正马上让戚无雍微勾起的嘴角僵住，微恼地瞪他一眼。「下次讲快一点。」
「是是是，下次改进。」王管事暗流着冷汗继续说：「他们毕竟还是商人，亏本的事情不会做太多，不过好奇心人皆有之，虽然喝个十壶的茶才能换来一杯半价新茶，大家还是趋之若鹜，我们的客人也就这样凑热闹跑光了。」
想起无戚茶楼以前的繁荣光景，再对照现在这凄凉的景象，王管事忍不住又想唉声叹气起来，简直是不胜唏嘘呀。
「那又如何？这种新鲜感也只是一时的，我想再过不久，大家就会对醉茗居这种把戏厌烦，也不会笨到先被骗了十壶茶的钱，才换得一杯更贵的不知道有什么名堂的茶。」
「四公子，这……可难说了。」
「为什么？」
「因为听说那个茶真的很特别，喝过的人都说好，而且是爱不释口，就像上了瘾——」
「王管事，来了，茶来了！」
就在这时，茶楼内其他的店小二突然从外捧回一杯茶，兴奋至极地马上端往三楼。「我们可是拚了老命才换来这杯茶，王管事您一定要好好珍惜呀！」
想他们五条好汉刚才可是硬拚完十壶茶，喝到肚子都快撑到破了，好不容易才换来这一小杯神秘的极品茶种，如果不小心浪费掉，他们可是没那个肚子及勇气再去挑战第二次连灌十壶茶了。
一拿过店小二递过来的茶，王管事慎重地端到戚无雍面前。「四公子，就是这一杯，我们可是因这一杯而输得凄惨无比呀。」
瞧他们个个脸色凝重，一副如临大敌的模样，戚无雍倒是轻笑一声，只觉得他们太小题大作了，就不信有什么事情可以难倒他。
「我就不信有什么好稀奇的，绝对是少见多……」一掀开茶盖，一股特殊浓郁的香气马上让戚无雍一愣，完全是出乎他的意料之外，接着他瞧向杯底，一片片对开的长针形茶瓣沈淀在下方，密合起来就像一朵盛开的菊花一样，不只香气四溢，还美丽无比。「这……银针茶？」
他简直是不敢相信，不明白醉茗居是去哪里拿到银针茶的？这个茶种不只珍贵且稀少，没有特殊管道的话，根本就拿不到这种茶。
「什么？银针茶？这下可好，我们茶楼根本没有任何茶可以比得上呀……」
谜底揭晓之后，马上引起大家一阵哗然，除了戚无雍之外，其他人大多只听过这传说中的茶种，根本就没机会见过，今天可真是大开眼界了。
王管事听到之后更是紧张了。「四公子，怎么办、怎么办，没想到醉茗居居然有办法弄到银针茶，我们该不该去拜访燕云山的……」
一提到那遥远的地方，戚无雍的眉头马上打结，显然很不想听到这个名字似的。「王管事，别告诉我，你打算拉着我一起上燕云山。」
「是没错呀，四公子，现在不上燕云山，是要怎样和醉茗居力拚呢？」
他们无戚茶楼的茶叶向来是由燕云山上专产茶叶的燕族所提供，历经好几代都是如此，现在要想拚过醉茗居最快的办法，就是找上燕族，请他们帮忙提供更特殊的茶种，来和醉茗居的银针茶一较高下。

身为茶楼主事者，遇到这种状况当然是该马上动身冲上燕云山，准备来和醉茗居拚个你死我活，但戚无雍却完全不是这么一回事，一听到要上山，他马上来个抵死不从。
「不，打死我也不再上燕云山了！」
「嗄？为什么？」
「反正我不去就是不去！」
为什么？就是因为他才去了一次，就被那难走的山路给怕到了，暗自发誓绝对不再走第二次！
想当年他还是个十六岁的少年，却为了要继承无戚茶楼的事业，被大哥硬拉着走一趟燕云山，不只让他尝到不少苦头，还因为水土不服而生病连连，不只被自己的大哥修理，也让燕族的人看笑话。
一回想起那丢脸的记忆，戚无雍更是排斥上燕云山，因为这是他一生中唯一的挫败，他宁愿绞尽脑汁想别的办法，也好过上一趟燕云山去活受罪。
content_en:
The Qi family, one of the most wealthy businessmen in the capital, is engaged in four types of businesses: teahouses, bureaus, cloth stores, and banks. Each of them is managed by the four sons of the Qi family. It can be said that everyone knows about it and its influence in the business world is terrifying.
No matter what kind of business the Qi family does, it is the most profitable in the capital, and no one can compare with it. However, since it is a big tree and attracts attention, there are naturally many people who are jealous of the Qi family's business. Of course, there are also many people who deliberately challenge and hold back.
"What's going on? I've only been away from Beijing temporarily for half a month, and the 'Wuqi Teahouse' is eerily quiet. There are only two or three kittens left for tea. It's extremely deserted."
See what's going on? The shopkeeper was so free that he was eating melon seeds, the waiter was so free that he dozed off aside, and even the two or three kittens who came in to drink tea were in a daze while drinking tea, and their whole soul did not know where their mind was wandering.
Sitting in the elegant seat on the third floor, Qi Wuyong, the fourth son in charge of the tea house business, propped his chin on one hand and looked at the deserted scene on the first and second floors. He was confused in his heart and didn't understand what was going on.
He was wearing a dark green high-grade brocade produced by his own cloth shop, with a fine white jade pendant tied around his waist. He naturally showed a natural arrogance of a noble man in his movements, which was hard to ignore. In addition, with his upright appearance and good family background, he was the favorite of many girls in the capital.
He frowned slightly and quickly looked through the account books sent by Manager Wang, only to realize that the tea house's business had declined rapidly in the past half month, just like falling from the top of a mountain into a valley. There is only one word to describe it, and that is "miserable"!
He just went out of town to visit long-lost friends, but as soon as he returned, Wuqi Teahouse changed its mood. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn't have believed that such a thing happened.
Could it be that Wuqi Teahouse, which has a long history and has been passed down from generation to generation, will fail at the hands of Qi Wuyong, the fourth son of the Qi family, and will be saddled with an eternal infamy, and will never be able to hold its head high in the Qi family again?
"Tsk, how can this be done? I will not let this happen!"
After closing the account book with a snap, Qi Wuyong immediately made a solemn face and called out with a sense of oppression: "Manager Wang."
"Yes, Fourth Young Master." Steward Wang, who had been accompanying him, responded quickly.
Steward Wang is very aware of his master's temper. In fact, his master is usually very casual and casual, and doesn't put on airs. But as long as his face is serious and he still exudes a faint aura that makes people feel pressured, it means that his master is angry, which cannot be ignored.
"What's going on at Wuqi Tea House in the past half month?"
When the tragic situation of Wuqi Tea House was mentioned, Manager Wang immediately grimaced and almost burst into tears. "It's not the "Zui Ming Ju" across the street, he just stole our customers."
"Drunken Mingju?" Qi Wuyong frowned angrily. "What did that teahouse do? It's so boring."
Speaking of the newly opened Zui Mingju in the past year, they also sell tea, but they always like to cause trouble for their Wuqi Tea House. They want to compete in terms of tea types, prices, and the service attitude of the waiters. They simply take pleasure in stealing Wuqi Tea House's customers.
"Fourth Young Master, it's like this. In the past half month, Zuimingju has launched a new rare tea. Regardless of your status, as long as you accumulate ten pots of tea in their store, you can drink the new rare tea, and the price is still..."
"Free?" Tsk tsk, that's really incredible. He was really worried that the drunk boss Wan would lose all his money because he wanted to defeat them, so he would laugh wildly...
"No, it's half price."
Manager Wang's correction immediately made Qi Wuyong's slightly raised corners of his mouth freeze, and he glared at him slightly angrily. "Speak faster next time."
"Yes, yes, let's improve next time." Manager Wang continued with a cold sweat: "They are still businessmen after all, and they won't do anything that makes them lose money."Many, but everyone is curious. Although it takes ten pots of tea to get a cup of new tea at half price, everyone still flocked to it, and all our guests just joined in the fun and ran away. "
Thinking of the former prosperity of Wuqi Tea House, and comparing it with the current desolate scene, Manager Wang couldn't help but want to sigh again, it was so sad.
"So what? This novelty is only temporary. I think in a short time, everyone will be tired of tricks like Zui Mingju, and they won't be so stupid that they were defrauded of ten pots of tea in exchange for a more expensive cup of tea."
"Fourth Young Master, this... is hard to say."
"Why?"
"Because I heard that the tea is really special. Everyone who has tried it says it's good, and they can't put it down. It's like being addicted——"
"Steward Wang, here you go, here comes the tea!"
At this moment, the other waiters in the teahouse suddenly brought back a cup of tea from outside, and they were so excited that they immediately carried it to the third floor. "We have worked hard to get this cup of tea. Manager Wang, you must cherish it!"
Thinking that these five heroes had just finished ten pots of tea, drinking until their stomachs were almost bursting. They had finally managed to get this small cup of mysterious top-quality tea. If they accidentally wasted it, they would not have the stomach or courage to challenge ten pots of tea for the second time.
As soon as he took the tea handed over by the waiter, Manager Wang carefully brought it to Qi Wuyong. "Fourth Young Master, it's just this one cup. We lost miserably because of this one cup."
Looking at their solemn expressions, as if they were facing a formidable enemy, Qi Wuyong chuckled lightly, feeling that they were making too much fuss and didn't believe anything could trouble him.
"I don't believe there is anything so rare. It's definitely rare..." As soon as he opened the lid of the tea, Qi Wuyong was stunned by a special and rich aroma. It was completely beyond his expectation. Then he looked at the bottom of the cup. Pieces of long needle-shaped tea petals settled below. When they were closed together, they looked like a blooming chrysanthemum. Not only was the fragrance overflowing, but it was also extremely beautiful. "This...Silver Needle Tea?"
He simply couldn't believe it and didn't understand where Zui Mingju got the Silver Needle Tea? This tea species is not only precious and rare, but without special channels, it is impossible to get this tea.
"What? Silver Needle Tea? This is so good. There is no tea in our teahouse that can compare..."
After the answer to the mystery was revealed, everyone was immediately in an uproar. Except for Qi Wuyong, most of the others had only heard of this legendary tea species and had never had the chance to see it. Today was really an eye-opener.
Manager Wang became even more nervous after hearing this. "Fourth Young Master, what should we do, what should we do? I didn't expect Zui Mingju to be able to get Silver Needle Tea. Should we visit Yanyun Mountain..."
As soon as he mentioned that distant place, Qi Wuyong's brows immediately knitted, as if he didn't want to hear the name. "Steward Wang, don't tell me that you plan to drag me up to Yanyun Mountain with you."
"That's right, Fourth Young Master, if you don't go to Yanyun Mountain now, how are you going to compete with Zui Mingju?"
The tea in their Wuqi Teahouse has always been provided by the Yan tribe who specializes in tea production in Yanyun Mountain. This has been the case for several generations. Now the fastest way to beat Zuimingju is to approach the Yan tribe and ask them to help provide more special tea varieties to compete with Zuimingju's Silver Needle Tea.
As the person in charge of the tea house, of course he should immediately rush up to Yanyun Mountain when encountering such a situation, preparing to fight to the death with Zui Mingju, but Qi Wuyong was not like that at all. As soon as he heard that he was going to go up the mountain, he immediately refused to obey.
"No, even if you kill me, I won't go to Yanyun Mountain again!"
"Huh? Why?"
"Anyway, if I don't go, I won't go!"
Why? Just because he had only been there once, he was frightened by the difficult mountain road and secretly vowed never to walk it a second time!
Think about those daysHe was still a sixteen-year-old boy, but in order to inherit the business of Wuqi Teahouse, he was forced to go to Yanyun Mountain by his elder brother. Not only did he suffer a lot, but he also got sick repeatedly because he was not accustomed to the climate. Not only was he repaired by his elder brother, but he also made the people of the Yan tribe laugh.
When he recalled that embarrassing memory, Qi Wuyong was even more reluctant to go to Yanyun Mountain, because this was the only setback in his life. He would rather rack his brains to think of other solutions than go to Yanyun Mountain and suffer.
